notes.title: Memory Lost Will Release in 2025!
notes.notes:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39252458/8a6f9b8e2584d1c3348caccd16fddfaf4bea2370.jpg

We are delighted to announce a ‘2025’ release window for Memory Lost on Steam! Discover a dystopian metropolis ravaged by unrelenting corporate battles where survival is only possible by shifting their consciousness into the bodies of their enemies and using their abilities and skills. 

With the release of Memory Lost: Chapter One, the entire first chapter of the full game, Magic Hazard studio has been gathering and analyzing valuable feedback from the Memory Lost community, taking this onboard and shaping the ongoing development to create a truly thrilling action-shooter experience.

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2129490/Memory_Lost_Chapter_One/

We have also released a thrilling new gameplay trailer packed with never-before-seen in-game footage to give you a glimpse into the frenetic top-down shooter action you can expect when Memory Lost launches in 2025! 
[previewyoutube=3OCsAWfwOPI;full][/previewyoutube]
Wishlist the game and check Memory Lost: Chapter One, which is available for PC to download from Steam for free now!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1483190/Memory_Lost/

notes.title: Memory Lost: Chapter One Receives Huge Content Update!
notes.notes:
We are happy to announce a massive update to Memory Lost: Chapter One! You can now play the entire first chapter of the full game by heading to Memory Lost: Chapter One  and jumping straight into the fresh, updated gameplay and seeing what’s in store for the full launch next year!

[previewyoutube=rvGlwLCvWfc;full][/previewyoutube]

The Memory Lost: Chapter One  was first launched in December 2022 and has delighted shooter fans with its innovative combat mechanics and fast-paced gameplay. Over the past 12 months, we’ve been gathering community and players feedback to support the ongoing development of the full game. As part of the continued development journey of Memory Lost, we will continue to use the valuable feedback gathered from the Memory Lost: Chapter One to enhance the full game experience.

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1483190/Memory_Lost/

Try Chapter One for free and wishlist Memory Lost!

notes.title: Game Release Window!
notes.notes:
Here we are! 

Today we want to share with you two very cool things. Firstly, we made a new furious gameplay trailer, by the way, here it is: 

[previewyoutube=rvGlwLCvWfc;full][/previewyoutube]

Secondly, this was done to announce the release window for the Memory Lost! Game will be available in Q4 2023 on PC, Nintendo Switch, Xbox Series X|S, Xbox One, and PlayStation 4|5 with English, French, Italian, German, Spanish, Polish, Russian, Chinese, Japanese and Turkish language support. 

Hell yes baby!

All the best,
Magic Hazard & ESDigital Games
